# opencollective_collective_member (Resource)

Manages a team member (admin, core contributor or accountant) of an Open Collective collective. Requires a `personal_token` with the `account` scope, belonging to an admin of the collective.

Creating this resource sends an invitation; `status` is `INVITED` until the invitee accepts it and `ACTIVE` afterwards. If the invitation is declined, or the member is removed outside OpenTofu, the resource disappears from state and the next apply sends a new invitation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opencollective_collective" "example" {
  name        = "My Project"
  slug        = "my-project"
  description = "Sustaining my open source project"
}

# Invites jane-doe as an admin. status is "INVITED" until she accepts.
resource "opencollective_collective_member" "jane" {
  collective_id = opencollective_collective.example.id
  member_slug   = "jane-doe"
  role          = "ADMIN"
  description   = "Lead maintainer"
  since         = "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}

resource "opencollective_collective_member" "bookkeeper" {
  collective_id = opencollective_collective.example.id
  member_slug   = "acme-accounting"
  role          = "ACCOUNTANT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collective_id` (String) Public ID of the collective, e.g. `opencollective_collective.example.id`.
- `member_slug` (String) Slug of the account to add, e.g. `jane-doe` for `https://opencollective.com/jane-doe`.
- `role` (String) Role of the member: `ADMIN`, `MEMBER` (core contributor) or `ACCOUNTANT`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the member's role, shown on the collective's page.
- `since` (String) Date the membership started (RFC 3339). Defaults to when the invitation is accepted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the membership, `<collective_id>/<member_account_id>`.
- `member_account_id` (String) Public ID of the member's account. Used to track the member if their slug changes.
- `status` (String) `INVITED` while the invitation is pending, `ACTIVE` once accepted.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A membership is imported as <collective id or slug>/<member slug>.
tofu import opencollective_collective_member.jane my-project/jane-doe
```
